certification.name: HackTricks GCP Red Team Expert
certification.description: Covers Google Cloud identity and access management, encryption, networking, misconfigurations across GCP services and pivoting between GCP and Google Workspace. Certification requires passing a practical exam of lab challenges solved by submitting flags within 12 hours; no report is required.
certification.currency_note: Vendor lists EUR only (list EUR 1,099, discounted to EUR 879 on 2026-11-10); converted at 1.1214 USD/EUR (ECB reference rate, 2026-11-10); course with 60 days of lab access and one exam attempt, exam not sold separately
